forum.title: Missing Peripheral Device on STM32C593
forum.best_answer_content:
You are right, it seems to be a limitation on the STM32 MCUs portfolio filters. I’ve reported this issue to ST people [here](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus-products/issues-on-the-stm32-portfolio-selector/m-p/897555#M295284) for correction. It is always better to double Check using the datasheet for such cases.

Best Regards.

II
forum.content_text: I am trying to learn how to program a STM32 micro-controller, specifically a STM32C593. The thing is according to its datasheet it has Ethernet functionality, bit it is missing in the peripheral list inside STM32CUBEMX2 IDE.
forum.author: accf1996

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @accf1996 

Could you please give the full part number to check. According to the table 1 of the DS15136, Ethernet peripheral is not available on some of the STM32C593 MCUs. 
Best Regards.

II
scraped_replies.author: Issamos

scraped_replies.html: I am trying to work with STM32C593CET6. I am looking for a low pin count device that has Ethernet functionality for a handheld device. The thing is according to its datasheet and the block diagram that appears on it that MCU has Ethernet capability.
scraped_replies.author: accf1996

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @accf1996 

According to the table 1 of the DS15136, the STM32C593CET6 does not include an Ethernet peripheral:

The smallest package that supports the Ethernet is the LQFP64 on the STM32C593RE and the STM32C593RG.

Best Regards.

II
scraped_replies.author: Issamos

scraped_replies.html: Thanks for your help. I selected that device using the MCU Portfolio selector. If I filtered the device selection by "Communication Interfaces" and "Special Interfaces" fields the MCU reference appears. Maybe I am using incorrectly the MCU Portfolio tool.
scraped_replies.author: accf1996

scraped_replies.html:
You are right, it seems to be a limitation on the STM32 MCUs portfolio filters. I’ve reported this issue to ST people here for correction. It is always better to double Check using the datasheet for such cases. 
Best Regards.

II

scraped_replies.html: @accf1996 - Seems that it is now fixed.
